ABOUT

A cyber security blog
without the conference voice.

Pints & Payloads is a home for security ramblings: red teaming, penetration testing, social engineering, physical security, cloud, Active Directory and the odd rabbit hole that starts with “I wonder if…”

The aim is simple: write about security like people actually talk about it. Practical, opinionated and understandable.

“The best security lesson is usually the one you can explain to someone over a pint.”
